description.value: The Jolly Coachman Pub and Liquor Store has been a community institution in Pitt Meadows since 1976, combining a full-service pub with an attached liquor store under one roof. The pub offers a varied daily menu spanning pub classics, pasta nights, prime rib dinners, and weekend breakfasts, alongside regular live music and community fundraising events that have raised over a million dollars locally. An online ordering system supports both pub food and liquor store purchases.

address.value: 19167 Ford Road, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2B6

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 16m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 42m; rack (5 spaces) at 56m. Total: 16 spaces.
